_noteQ: Q (Super Scorcher Breath) FIXED (loop 221) -- no longer left auto:true/uncurated. TotalDamage = NamedDataValue(BaseDamage, real ranks 60/70/80/90/100) + StatByNamedDataValue(mStat=2, mStatFormula=2 -> bonus AD, ratio 1.3), wrapped in mMultiplier 1+ProductOfSubParts[StatByNamedDataValue(mStat=8,CritRatio), SumOfSubParts[-1, StatByCoefficient(mStat=9)]]. Both mStat 8/9 resolve to 0.0 in the current engine (§26 no-crit floor) so the multiplier is always 1 and TotalDamage cleanly resolves to the Tier-1 (no Dragon Practice stacks) base breath damage -- matches wiki 'Base Physical Damage (Tier 1): 60/70/80/90/100 (+130% bonus AD)' exactly, Physical. This represents the FLOOR/no-stacks case only -- Tier2 (knockback, +125 flat via a BuffCounterByCoefficient) and Tier3 (execute+DoT+true-damage-conversion via BuffCounterByNamedDataValue) remain genuinely infeasible (live Dragon Practice stack count not tracked by this engine), same documented reasoning as before, just no longer used as an excuse to leave the whole ability at zero.
_noteW: W (Achooo!) is a real 2-part hit: 'InitialDamage' (BaseDamage + 0.6x bonus AD, the sneeze impact) plus 'ExplosionDamage' (ExplosionBaseDamage + 0.5x bonus AD + 0.8 AP, the follow-up mucus burst that only triggers on hitting a champion) -- both curated Physical per live tooltip text ('deals physical damage ... explosion dealing physical damage plus bonus magic damage'); the small AP term inside ExplosionDamage is the formula's own bonus-magic component folded into one number, matching this project's existing convention of a single dominant type per hit rather than splitting every mixed-ratio calc. The Dragon Practice bonus-magic addon (stack-based) is not modeled for the same BuffCounter-infeasibility reason as Q.
_noteE: E (Flap, Flap, Flap!) autonomously fires bolts at the most-wounded visible enemy while Smolder is airborne; 'DamagePerHit' = BaseDamage + 0.3x TOTAL AD (mStat 2, no mStatFormula -> total not bonus, per BIN), Physical per live tooltip.
